name: bld_frobenius_rank_inequality
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n p q : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) (C : Matrix p q K) : Matrix.rank (A * B) + Matrix.rank (B * C) ≤ Matrix.rank B + Matrix.rank (A * B * C)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n p q : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) (C : Matrix p q K), Matrix.rank (A * B) + Matrix.rank (B * C) ≤ Matrix.rank B + Matrix.rank (A * B * C)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_lin_sylvester_rank_rect: take a rank factorisation B = M * N with M : n × Fin r, N : Fin r × p, r = rank B; apply the rectangular Sylvester inequality to (A*M) and (N*C) to get rank(AM) + rank(NC) ≤ r + rank(ABC), then rank(AB) ≤ rank(AM) and rank(BC) ≤ rank(NC).
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (m : Type u_2) (n : Type u_3) (p : Type u_4) (q : Type u_5) [Fintype m] [inst_2 : Fintype n] [inst_3 : Fintype p] [inst_4 : Fintype q] (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) (C : Matrix p q K), (A * B).rank + (B * C).rank ≤ B.rank + (A * B * C).rank
